sanitizedDoneEvidenceRequired.preflight: Fresh root toy doctor --deep --json; inspect bootstrap.resource-admission before the exact pending command. Require normal pressure and at least 1,073,741,824 available bytes; overall doctor exit 5 may remain because unrelated R0 gates are pending.
sanitizedDoneEvidenceRequired.rootRun: Run only the exact request02 command with its request, artifact, and child pins. Append its sanitized public JSON and verification output to the same ROOT-R004-20261006-02 entry, then mark DONE only for exit 0, state verified, reason CONTROL_RUNTIME_READ_VERIFIED.
sanitizedDoneEvidenceRequired.identityAndRead: Report callerUid 0; controlUid/controlGid 310; child real/effective uid and gid 310 with groups [310]; moduleImported true; actual keychainState absent or present; helperExitCode 3 for absent or 0 for present.
sanitizedDoneEvidenceRequired.integrityAndEffects: Require artifactVerified, backupWritten, parentModesRestored, and bootstrapReceiptUnchanged true; receipt digest 980a7bbd94f61e8a5e4d0bec1860555091e7aa303b7981df4392a6f5ee49fe65. Require credentialBytesCaptured, credentialWritten, currentPointerChanged, servicesActivated false; liveProviderSends 0; acceptanceComplete false.
sanitizedDoneEvidenceRequired.neverInclude: Helper stdout/stderr, Keychain/vault bytes or values, grant/token contents, environment values, or free-form exception text. If helper state is unavailable, module import fails, identity/integrity checks fail, or parent modes are not restored, record FAILED and stop before source work.

workflowAssessment.currentRootRequest: The queued request uses the exact pinned repository probe and staging verifier under the documented root-request path. Its probe reports only bounded state; a real absent or present result does not disclose credential contents. No alternate profile, helper, route, or account is authorized.
workflowAssessment.futureOwnerLoadPlan: The source placement is bounded to the existing root-owned probe, but the next source version needs its own immutable staged artifact and a new exact ROOT-REQUESTS entry before root execution; request02 only authorizes its current frozen digests. The keychain-owner-next-step rootPreparationRule requires that new concrete request.
workflowAssessment.secretReadLimit: This plan prevents secret disclosure, but it is not literally a zero-secret-read operation: public SiwcGrantOwner.load calls the native keychain store read and parses the complete vault, including a grant if present, inside the child. The baseline-byte comparison also reads bytes privately. The plan keeps these values in child memory and forbids output, evidence, parent, or model exposure. If the requirement is to avoid any in-process secret read, stop after request02 and do not execute the owner-load extension.

minimumNextSourceScopeAfterValidDone.operation: After request02 proves a real present/absent helper result under UID/GID310 and restores parents, add one bounded owner-load/readback extension using only generated SiwcKeychainLauncherV1 validation, public createMacOsSiwcKeychain, and public SiwcGrantOwner.load. Do not call read, retainClientId, or save on the owner.
minimumNextSourceScopeAfterValidDone.existingVault: Privately compare before/after bytes around two independent public load instances; preserve registration and grant. Emit only bounded booleans/state.
minimumNextSourceScopeAfterValidDone.absentVault: Permit only public load's canonical empty host-vault initialization; verify host metadata and null registration, pending client, and grant in child memory, then fresh-load and privately confirm identical bytes. Never overwrite a concurrent nonempty value.
minimumNextSourceScopeAfterValidDone.receipt: Reuse the existing sanitized report; if it cannot distinguish the proof, add only the planned finite ownerLoadState and freshLoadVerified fields to that same report contract.
minimumNextSourceScopeAfterValidDone.disallowed: No grant/token creation or update, consent, OAuth/provider call, service activation, pointer change, message, secret bytes/digest/length, host ID, registration, grant, or exception text in output.
